policy_presence.summary: Imperial publishes official generative AI principles and the institutional dAIsy platform; this does not establish a single university-wide classroom AI policy.

ai_disclosure.summary: Imperial Library recommends acknowledgment in assessed work. When dAIsy is permitted for assessed work, its Use Policy requires acknowledgment; follow the department or assessment brief for the required details.

coursework.summary: Departments decide assessment permissions individually. Unauthorised AI use in assessed work may be treated as academic misconduct.

exams.summary: No universal exam permission or prohibition is established by this reviewed record. Check specific exam instructions; tool access does not convey exam permission.

privacy_data_entry.summary: dAIsy is approved for unrestricted data within Imperial infrastructure. Copilot Chat has enterprise protections and Exchange audit logging; enabled web grounding can send generated queries to the separate Bing service under different terms. Follow applicable institutional data rules.

academic_integrity.summary: Imperial does not use Turnitin's AI-writing detection in assessment in 2026–27. The ten College working-day appeal deadline applies under the Academic Misconduct procedure following formal notification of the relevant decision. Postgraduate research misconduct is routed to Ordinance D17; this record does not establish its appeal deadline.

approved_tools.summary: dAIsy is Imperial's institutional platform. Basic access is provided to staff and students; Developer access is restricted to approved staff. Access is subject to token quotas and does not grant assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Selected GPT, Claude, and DeepSeek models are accessible via dAIsy. This does not establish standalone vendor subscriptions or assessment use permissions.

teaching_guidance.summary: Imperial presents three areas of generative AI principles underpinned by five core Values. Departmental assessment permissions remain specific to the course or task.

research_guidance.summary: Research involving personal data, sensitive topics, or people may require ethics approval, a DPIA, and data-governance controls before AI use.

security_procurement.summary: dAIsy uses SSO and audit logging within Imperial's secure infrastructure. Data handling is governed by institutional IT Conditions of Use.
